items.title: Harvest a Prickeye
items.detail: Fast travel to Tycoon Lake in Burning Springs and harvest orange bulbs, or plant in C.A.M.P.

items.title: Complete a Grunt Hunt
items.detail: Start at Highway Town bounty board in Burning Springs, track and eliminate the assigned Outlaw.

items.title: Harvest a Wild Plant or Fungi
items.detail: Harvest from the wild or plant vegetables in C.A.M.P. to gather on demand.

items.title: Kill a Pint-Sized Phantom during an Infestation while on a Team
items.detail: Join a team, find an active Infestation on the map, and kill Phantoms in the hotspot.

items.title: Kill a Wendigo
items.detail: Fast travel to Vault 51, head to the Atrium and north through dining area; target the head with V.A.T.S.

items.title: Sell Glowing Fungus Soup to an NPC vendor
items.detail: Gather glowing fungus at the Wayward, craft soup with boiled water and wood, sell to any vendor.

items.title: Visit another Player's Shelter
items.detail: Fast travel to another player's C.A.M.P. and enter their Shelter (marked with radiation symbol).

items.title: Drink Tea
items.detail: Use C.A.M.P. Company Tea generator or find tea and drink it.

items.title: Kill a Mole Miner
items.detail: Fast travel to Blackwater Mine and kill Mole Miner; target head with V.A.T.S.

items.title: Kill a Pint-Sized Phantom during a Daily Operation while on a Team
items.detail: Join a team, enter Daily Ops, and kill Pint-Sized Phantoms (masked cultists); no need to finish the operation.

items.title: Kill a Rusted Deathclaw
items.detail: Fast travel to Dino Peaks Mini Golf where three spawn; target belly with V.A.T.S.

items.title: Kill an Uninvited Pint-Sized Phantom
items.detail: Complete a Mischief Night event at Rapidan Camp, stay in Vertibot area for Phantom to spawn.

items.title: Scrap junk to produce Aluminum
items.detail: Craft Bulk Aluminum at a Tinker's Workbench and scrap it.

items.title: Scrap junk to produce Antiseptic
items.detail: Scrap Abraxo cleaner, industrial solvent, turpentine, or tick blood sacs at any workbench.

items.title: Sell Mirelurk Queen Steak to an NPC vendor
items.detail: Hunt Mirelurk queen at Mac's Farm or Spruce Knob Lake, cook steak, sell to any vendor.

items.title: Travel on foot (KM)
items.detail: Sprint in open ground with weapon holstered; Vault-Tec Agricultural Research Center to Morgantown works well.

items.title: Complete a Gold Star Daily Challenge
items.detail: Complete all six other daily challenges on three separate days during the week.

events.name: Slasher C.A.M.P. Contest
events.description: Build contest for slasher-inspired C.A.M.P.s and shelters with atom and exclusive title prizes.

events.name: Mischief Night
events.description: Seasonal Halloween event featuring the Slasher-themed Pint-Sized Phantom cultists and themed rewards.

events.name: Double Mutations
events.description: Increased mutation spawn rates during Daily Operations with new seasonal rewards.

events.name: Spooky Scorched
events.description: Seasonal event featuring spooky scorched enemies with exclusive rewards and cosmetics.

events.name: Double XP
events.description: Doubled experience gain across all activities and quests.

events.name: Seasonal Fish Run Weekend
events.description: Increased chance to catch seasonal fish with new recipes and challenges.
